info.title: Loop workspace event channels
info.description: Companion to openapi.json. Event variants describe canonical decoded output; unknown or malformed events decode to invalidate. Serialized byte/depth bounds remain runtime constraints. No client writes are accepted on this socket.

events.description: Owner session on the server; paired device session on the host. Cards tokens are not accepted. v=3 negotiates these frames; other or absent versions retain legacy v2. epoch and cursor resume replay; clock=1 and projection=1 negotiate clock and capability additions. The first value of each query key is used.
